title: Field list
summary: A titled description list: term and value pairs as slotted dt and dd, beside each other, stacked or run in; with dividers and a dense mode.

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level exposed to assistive technology.

props.name: layout
props.description: Term beside value, or above it.

slots.description: dt and dd pairs; a dd may hold chips, links or code.

cssProperties.name: --pk-field-list-columns
cssProperties.description: The whole column template, for a page that re-flows the list (a flyout on a phone sizes the term to its text; a wide card runs two pairs per line).
cssProperties.default: term column and 2fr; one column on a phone

cssProperties.name: --pk-field-list-gap
cssProperties.description: Row and column gap on a phone.

a11y: A real description list: slotted dt and dd are exposed as terms and definitions. The heading names the section. Below 640px the pairs stack.
contentStylesNote: Slotted dt and dd are styled from the shadow root with ::slotted (they are direct children). Anything inside them (a code element, an info tip) is light DOM and takes the page styles.
